messages:
Ashley K.: Quick check — I'm planning a small "week-ahead" tidy to sweep the Runbooks/playbooks for stale redirects and 404s. Thinking Monday morning to run fixes + small PRs. Who's owning runbooks under runtime/playbooks and prod-playbook?
Matt P.: I can take runtime/playbooks (2 files). will start with a quick lint and link scan tomorrow.
Ashley K.: Awesome, thanks @Matt P.! CI reported a 404 in the prod-playbook curl example earlier. Logged output: ```curl -I https://cdn.redwood-inference/internal/prod-playbook/v1/runbook.md  404```  If you find the broken reference, prefer swapping to the canonical shortlink or rehost.
Hema R.: I own the onboarding playbook, not the prod one, but can help review cross-links if you want a second pair of eyes.
Matt P.: noted. I'll grep for `prod-playbook` and `runtime/playbooks` occurrences, patch redirects or replace with `/playbooks/prod-playbook` canonical links.
Tom S.: docs-bot just posted a scan summary that might help: "3 broken links, 1 redirect warning in /runbooks and /playbooks; highest impact: prod-playbook sample curl" (see thread below).
docs-bot: [link-scan] https://internal-redwood.tools/scans/scan-17755 — results attached.
Ashley K.: Plan: Matt fixes the runtime files + the prod-playbook curl example; Hema will review cross-link churn; I'll shepherd the CRs and schedule the follow-up QA check on Staging. If anyone needs this moved to a short sprint ticket, say so now.
Hema R.: Fine with that. If you hit any image 403s while editing, ping me — I have a small script to rehost screenshots.
Matt P.: Starting the grep now. Will ping here with PR link when ready (keeping changes minimal).
Ashley K.: Perfect. Thanks team :slightly_smiling_face: — targeting merge by Mon 10am PT and a quick staging smoke afterwards.
Tom S.: +1
Matt P.: PR: https://git.internal.redwood/p/docs/merge/1234 — short description: replace broken prod-playbook curl with canonical shortlink + fix two runtime link redirects. Please review when you have a moment.
Hema R.: Reviewing now. small nit: update one alt text on the hosted-arch diagram.
Ashley K.: Great — leaving the thread open for final + any post-merge fallout notes.
Tom S.: If staging smoke passes, I'll mark the runbook as "verified" in the runbook index.
Ashley K.: thanks all! :rocket:
